title: Rafael and the Machine
author: Mara Thornbury
blurb: Petra Dunmore, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
